messages:
mina: kicking off config-only for tonight's change window (01:00-01:30 UTC). goal: tighten tenant rate-caps and shorten batching window to reduce tail. canary=1%.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy_id=deploy-3141592653 mode=config-only target=prod canary=1%
hugo: oncall ack. i'll watch tenant error rates and p99 traces.
mina: config diff:
```yaml
routing:
  tenant_rate_cap_qps: 10
  min_route_weight_pct: 2
batching:
  window_ms: 8
  max_batch_size: 40
  per_request_bypass_size: 12
timeouts:
  head_ms: 950
  stream_idle_ms: 30000
```
tara: launching canary to low-traffic cohorts now
deploy-bot: canary live -> tweak-variant receives 1% traffic
obs-bot: canary metrics (5m): p50=37ms p95=145ms p99=310ms 5xx=0.00%
hugo: small tail on tenant zebra-app p99=520ms, traces show one-off large requests queuing ~110ms for batch fill.
mina: pausing ramp. plan: hotpatch tweak to decrease window_ms->6 and add per_request_wait_ms=6 for canary. include rollback cmd.
deploy-bot: hotpatch started: patch_id=patch-3141593001; command: `/deploy config-only --patch '{"batching":{"window_ms":6,"per_request_wait_ms":6}}' --to prod --variant=tweak --canary 1%'
obs-bot: hotpatch canary (3m): p50=35ms p95=138ms p99(zebra-app)=220ms 5xx=0.00%
mina: looks better. recommending ramp to 20% over 10m. rollback instruction: `/deploy rollback deploy-3141592653` or reapply cfg hash cfg-pi314.
ops-bot: if rollback happens, run `ops migrate-routing --to previous` and notify #oncall.
mina: ramping patch-3141593001 -> 20%
obs-bot: 20% stable after 11m; p95 down, p99 within +20ms baseline, no error uptick.
tara: pinning cfg-pi314 to variant v18 for 24h. rollback criteria: tenant 5xx >0.4% or sustained p99 delta +200ms for 5m. owner=mina, rollback-owner=hugo.
mina: release notes: "Config-only: tenant_rate_cap_qps set to 10, batching.window_ms 12->8 then hotpatched to 6 for canary, max_batch_size 64->40, added per_request_bypass_size and per_request_wait_ms to reduce head-of-line waits. Pinned cfg-pi314 to v18 for 24h. Change window closed 01:19 UTC."
hugo: thanks team. closing unless alerts fire. :white_check_mark:
